problem:
A license plate has an ordered combination of $7$ possible characters, as shown below:

| Letter or digit | Letter or digit | Letter or digit | Letter or digit | Letter or digit | Letter or digit | Letter or digit |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

Here,

- each "Letter" can be any capital from A-Z ($26$ in total), and

- each "Digit" can be any integer between $0$-$9.$

How many possible ordered combinations are there?
